content: The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 10 AM to 2 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
How much does a consultation cost?
General consultation: Ksh 500, Specialist consultation: Ksh 1000, Laboratory tests: Prices vary depending on the test.
How can I book an appointment?
You can book an appointment by calling our clinic at +254 712 334455 or by visiting our website and filling out the appointment form.
We offer general consultations, specialist consultations, laboratory tests, vaccinations, and antenatal care.
